accounts_type_class_check.name: accounts_type_class_check
accounts_type_class_check.value:
(
        ("ledger"."accounts"."type" in ('checking', 'savings', 'cash', 'brokerage', 'retirement', 'crypto') and "ledger"."accounts"."kind" = 'asset')
        or ("ledger"."accounts"."type" in ('credit_card', 'loan', 'mortgage') and "ledger"."accounts"."kind" = 'liability')
        or "ledger"."accounts"."type" = 'other'
      )

connections_authorization_check.name: connections_authorization_check
connections_authorization_check.value:
("ops"."connections"."status" = 'pending' and "ops"."connections"."authorized_at" is null and "ops"."connections"."credential_generation" = 0)
        or ("ops"."connections"."status" = 'revoked' and "ops"."connections"."credential_generation" >= 0)
        or ("ops"."connections"."status" not in ('pending', 'revoked') and "ops"."connections"."credential_generation" > 0)

connections_expiry_check.name: connections_expiry_check
connections_expiry_check.value: "ops"."connections"."expires_at" is null or "ops"."connections"."authorized_at" is null or "ops"."connections"."expires_at" > "ops"."connections"."authorized_at"
